subject: history
concept: Understanding what causes a revolution: widespread grievances combined with an opportunity for change
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts grievance cards (unfair taxes, no voice in government, unequal treatment) that commonly lead to revolutions
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a historical grievance to the type of change people demanded
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in general terms, what conditions tend to lead to a revolution

misconception_flags: believes revolutions happen suddenly with no underlying causes or buildup

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
